title: Rhythm Heaven Megamix
subtitle: Nintendo SPD / TNX · Nintendo 3DS

body: Rhythm Heaven Megamix is Nintendo and TNX's Nintendo 3DS collection of rhythm games. The player helps Tibby return home by completing scenes whose actions follow a musical pattern. Returning activities from the Game Boy Advance, DS and Wii games share the journey with new ones. A short instruction introduces each task, then the sound supplies the timing. The situations can involve unlikely creatures and everyday chores, but their common demand is simple: recognise when the next action belongs in the phrase and carry it out cleanly.

Buttons provide the main controls, with an alternative touchscreen scheme also available. A timing display shows whether an input arrived early or late, giving a missed action more useful information than a failed score alone. Certain moments award a Skill Star for precise performance. The challenge lies in holding the pattern through rests, changes and interruptions. Once the gesture is familiar, the player has to trust the sound, resisting the urge to follow a distracting movement or answer before the music reaches its cue.

Remix stages switch between learned activities within a shared musical sequence. Recognising the returning scene is only the beginning: its action must arrive in time even as another task replaces it. Challenge Train provides additional variations, including local multiplayer challenges and WarioWare-themed appearances. Strong performances earn currency for bonus games and collectibles. Megamix treats the earlier series as a repertoire worth playing again, then changes the combinations so that familiar gestures can still produce a fresh test of attention and timing.
